title: What Banks Won’t Tell You About SBA Loan Defaults
description:
What really happens if you default on your SBA 7(a) loan?

In this episode of the DealMakers Podcast, I sit down with Eric Rabinovich from Live Oak Bank—one of the country’s top SBA lenders—to demystify the scary stuff: loan defaults, special assets, personal guarantees, and everything the internet glosses over.

Whether you're about to buy your first firm, already juggling post-close cash flow, or just love a good “what-if” scenario (hello anxiety spiral), this conversation is a must-listen. 

We cover:

✅ What actually triggers a loan default—and what happens next
✅ What “special assets” means (spoiler: it's not great)
✅ What banks can do to help if you're upfront (yes, before you miss a payment)
✅ The impact of defaulting within your first 18 months
✅ What happens to your personal assets, like your house or that vacation property
✅ Why communication with your lender is your #1 defense tool

We also talk about Live Oak’s new Express Loan product (hello, sub-$500k deals!) and why default rates in accounting firm M&A are shockingly low.

This is the episode I wish every buyer watched before signing on the dotted line.
